articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Extended Context and Improved Reasoning
articles.summary: OpenAI announced GPT-5 Turbo, featuring a 2-million token context window and significantly enhanced multi-step reasoning capabilities. The model demonstrates a 40% improvement on complex math and coding benchmarks compared to its predecessor. Enterprise customers gain access immediately, with a broader rollout expected next week.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Tops Major Multimodal Benchmarks
articles.summary: Google DeepMind published results showing Gemini 2.5 Ultra achieving state-of-the-art scores across video understanding, image reasoning, and audio transcription tasks. The model edges out competing systems on the newly standardized OmniEval benchmark suite. Researchers noted particular gains in long-form video comprehension exceeding 90 minutes of content.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Agents Platform for Autonomous Workflow Automation
articles.summary: Anthropic launched a dedicated agentic platform allowing Claude models to autonomously manage multi-step business workflows, including web browsing, code execution, and API integrations. The platform includes a new safety layer called Constitutional Guardrails that limits unauthorized actions during autonomous runs. Early enterprise partners report up to 60% reduction in manual operational overhead.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins: First Compliance Deadlines Hit Major Tech Firms
articles.summary: The European Union's AI Act entered its first major enforcement phase this week, requiring high-risk AI systems deployed in the EU to meet strict transparency and audit requirements. Several large technology companies including Meta and Microsoft confirmed they have submitted compliance documentation to national authorities. Industry analysts warn that non-compliant firms could face fines of up to 3% of global annual turnover.

articles.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio Adds Native RAG Pipeline Builder for Enterprise Knowledge Bases
articles.summary: Microsoft unveiled an integrated retrieval-augmented generation pipeline builder within Copilot Studio, enabling enterprises to connect proprietary document stores without custom coding. The tool supports hybrid search combining dense vector retrieval with BM25 keyword matching, and includes automatic chunk optimization. The feature is now available in preview for Microsoft 365 E5 subscribers.

articles.title: Meta Releases LLaMA 4 Scout Open-Source Model with 400 Billion Parameters
articles.summary: Meta open-sourced LLaMA 4 Scout, a 400-billion parameter model available under a permissive research and commercial license. The model reportedly matches GPT-5 Turbo performance on several standard benchmarks while remaining fully downloadable for self-hosting. The release has energized the open-source AI community, with thousands of fine-tuned variants already appearing on Hugging Face within 24 hours.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Report Warns of Accelerating AI-Enabled Disinformation Risks Ahead of 2026 Midterms
articles.summary: Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute released a comprehensive report outlining growing threats from AI-generated disinformation as US midterm elections approach in November 2026. Researchers documented a 300% year-over-year increase in synthetic media designed to impersonate political candidates. The report calls for mandatory watermarking of AI-generated political content and faster platform-level detection tools.

articles.title: Mistral AI Launches Le Chat Pro with Real-Time Web Search and Code Interpreter
articles.summary: Paris-based Mistral AI upgraded its Le Chat assistant to a Pro tier featuring live web search integration, an in-browser code interpreter, and file analysis capabilities. The offering positions Mistral as a direct competitor to ChatGPT Plus and Google Gemini Advanced in the European market. Pricing is set at €18 per month, with a free tier retaining access to the base Mistral Large model.
